UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated trader preferences and bot configuration for MN Shah Bot.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the bot greeting.

voiceAlertsEnabled.description: Whether Urdu TTS alerts play automatically for new signals.

autoMonitorEnabled.description: Whether the robot continuously monitors live feeds while open.

preferredAsset.description: Default market pair selected on launch.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was last updated.

SignalRecord.title: SignalRecord
SignalRecord.description: Immutable AI technical analysis signal with multi-timeframe indicators and Urdu explanation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signal owner.

direction.description: Estimated next 1-minute candle direction or WAIT when evidence is insufficient.

confidence.description: Confidence percentage 0-100 derived from technical alignment.

entryPrice.description: Live spot price at time of analysis.

patternSummary.description: Detected candlestick pattern and market structure.

urduSummary.description: Urdu explanation spoken by MN Shah robot.

evidenceSummary.description: Detailed technical evidence behind the signal.

dataSource.description: Market feed source identifier and status.

candleExpiryEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the analyzed 1-minute candle expires.

TradeConfirmation.title: TradeConfirmation
TradeConfirmation.description: Explicit manual real-trade confirmation audit entry (no automatic or demo execution).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the trader.

stakeUsd.description: Authorized position size / stake in USD.

brokerName.description: Authorized broker channel or manual execution ledger.

status.description: Current audit state of the confirmed trade.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile and MN Shah autonomous robot preferences.

/users/{userId}/signals/{signalId}.description: User-scoped immutable log of AI trading signals and technical evidence.

/users/{userId}/trade_confirmations/{tra.description: User-scoped manual real-trade confirmation audit ledger.
